name: Add Asset
description: Request or add a new SVG asset to the CDN (mark or badge)
assignees: rastislavcore
labels: asset, enhancement
---

You only add **one SVG file** in either `mark/base/` or `badge/base/`. All sizes (16–1024px) and PNG exports are **autogenerated** by the build script.

## Location

- [ ] **Mark** — add SVG to `mark/base/{name}.svg`
- [ ] **Badge** — add SVG to `badge/base/{name}.svg`

## Asset name
<!-- e.g. mycoin, myapp — used as filename: {name}.svg -->

## Source
<!-- Link to official logo/source or attach the SVG. Base SVG must be single viewBox (e.g. 0 0 1024 1024), no <g> groups. -->

## Notes
<!-- Any extra context. -->
